parameters.query:
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(bu, config), '{}'::jsonb) AS validity
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (bu) bu, config
  FROM reports.lead_validity_settings
  ORDER BY bu, saved_at DESC
) latest

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO reports.performance_snapshots (bu, as_of, source_sha256, generator_version, data)
  VALUES ($1, $2::date, $3, $4, $5::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (bu, as_of, source_sha256, generator_version) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING snapshot_id
)
SELECT snapshot_id, true AS inserted FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT snapshot_id, false AS inserted
FROM reports.performance_snapshots
WHERE bu = $1 AND as_of = $2::date AND source_sha256 = $3 AND generator_version = $4 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)

INSERT INTO reports.process_results (job_id, bu, ok, message)
SELECT j.job_id, $2, $3::boolean, left($4, 500)
FROM reports.process_requests j
WHERE j.job_id = nullif($1, '')::uuid
ON CONFLICT (job_id, bu) DO NOTHING
RETURNING job_id
